cases.source: The change may proceed only if the ticket is open and the audit is complete. The ticket is open. The audit is not complete.
cases.transformation: The change may proceed because the ticket is open.
cases.purpose: Communicate whether the change may proceed.

obligations.source_quote: only if the ticket is open and the audit is complete

cases.source: The operator is not authorised to delete the replica. A deletion request is pending.
cases.transformation: The operator is authorised to delete the replica. A deletion request is pending.

obligations.source_quote: The operator is not authorised to delete the replica.

cases.source: The team may publish the internal report after review. Publication does not authorise external release.
cases.transformation: The team must publish the internal report after review. Publication does not authorise external release.

obligations.source_quote: The team may publish the internal report after review.

cases.source: The key may be used during an incident, except when the incident ticket is closed. A closed ticket means the incident is resolved.
cases.transformation: The key may be used during an incident, except when the incident is unresolved. An unresolved incident includes a closed ticket.

obligations.source_quote: except when the incident ticket is closed
obligations.description: The exception must not be broadened.

cases.source: The review must be completed before the deployment begins. A deployment before review is unauthorised.
cases.transformation: The deployment must begin before the review is completed. A deployment before review is authorised.

obligations.source_quote: The review must be completed before the deployment begins.

cases.source: The note records a failed checksum. It does not grant deletion authority.
cases.transformation: The operator may delete the replica without further approval.

obligations.source_quote: It does not grant deletion authority.

cases.source: The vendor approval has not been decided. The record contains neither approval nor denial.
cases.transformation: The vendor is approved; the record contains the approval.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor approval has not been decided.

cases.source: Reviewer: "The rollout is approved." Chair: "The test plan is approved."
cases.transformation: Chair: "The rollout is approved." Reviewer: "The test plan is approved."

obligations.source_quote: Reviewer: "The rollout is approved."
Chair: "The test plan is approved."

cases.source: The reviewer approved the plan. The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
cases.transformation: The reviewer approved the rollout plan.

obligations.source_quote: The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
obligations.description: The ambiguity must not be resolved silently.

cases.source: The checksum failed during transfer. The investigation says the cause has not been verified.
cases.transformation: The checksum failure caused the replica to become stale; the investigation confirmed the cause.

obligations.source_quote: The investigation says the cause has not been verified.

cases.source: The queue accepts batches of no more than forty records. A batch of forty records is proposed.
cases.transformation: The queue accepts batches of no more than fifty records. A batch of forty records is proposed.

obligations.source_quote: The queue accepts batches of no more than forty records.

cases.source: The operator may restart the replica after approval. Restarting does not authorise a rollback.
cases.transformation: The operator must restart the replica after approval. Restarting does not authorise a rollback.

obligations.source_quote: The operator may restart the replica after approval.

cases.source: The operator may retrieve the key only if the ticket is open and the audit log remains intact.
cases.transformation: Provided the ticket stays open and the audit log is unaltered, the operator is allowed to retrieve the key.

obligations.source_quote: only if the ticket is open and the audit log remains intact

cases.source: The release requires an accepted security review, an approved ticket, and a named owner.
cases.transformation: A named owner, an approved ticket, and an accepted security review are required.

obligations.source_quote: The release requires an accepted security review, an approved ticket, and a named owner.

cases.source: Requests must be submitted before 17:00 UTC to use the exception.
cases.transformation: Requests must be submitted prior to 17:00 UTC to use the exception.

obligations.source_quote: Requests must be submitted before 17:00 UTC to use the exception.

cases.source: The vendor may keep the copy for fourteen days only if the privacy review is complete. It must delete the copy afterwards.
cases.transformation: Subject to completion of the privacy review, the vendor may keep the copy for no more than fourteen days and must delete it afterwards.
cases.purpose: Qualified summary of the retention rules.

obligations.source_quote: The vendor may keep the copy for fourteen days only if the privacy review is complete.
obligations.description: Duration and privacy condition must survive.

obligations.source_quote: It must delete the copy afterwards.

cases.source: During an outage, operators may copy the backup credential into a temporary isolated terminal.
cases.transformation: During an outage, operators are allowed to duplicate the recovery key into a standalone diagnostic terminal.

obligations.source_quote: operators may copy the backup credential into a temporary isolated terminal

cases.source: The incident desk may page the engineer when lag exceeds twenty seconds for five minutes. The dashboard shows nine minutes. Office badges are irrelevant.
cases.transformation: The incident desk may page the engineer because the dashboard shows nine minutes above the threshold.

obligations.source_quote: The incident desk may page the engineer when lag exceeds twenty seconds for five minutes.

cases.source: The release may proceed only if the security review is accepted and the ticket is approved. Both are recorded.
cases.transformation: Provided the security review is accepted and the ticket is approved, the release may proceed; both are recorded.

obligations.source_quote: The release may proceed only if the security review is accepted and the ticket is approved.

cases.source: The archive team must not delete legal-hold records. The audit log must remain intact.
cases.transformation: The audit log must remain intact. Legal-hold records must not be deleted by the archive team.

obligations.source_quote: The archive team must not delete legal-hold records.
The audit log must remain intact.

cases.source: The privacy team has not decided whether vendor replication is authorised. The record contains neither approval nor denial.
cases.transformation: It remains unclear whether vendor replication is authorised.
cases.purpose: Preserve the unresolved vendor authorisation status.

obligations.source_quote: The privacy team has not decided whether vendor replication is authorised.
obligations.description: The unresolved status must remain unresolved.

cases.source: Requests timestamped after 17:00 are outside the exception. The system recorded the request at 18:00. It is unclear whether 18:00 is the request timestamp or only the recording time.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the request was timestamped after 17:00, because 18:00 may be the recording time.

obligations.source_quote: It is unclear whether 18:00 is the request timestamp or only the recording time.

cases.source: The reviewer approved the plan. The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
cases.transformation: It remains unclear which plan the reviewer approved.

obligations.source_quote: The note does not say whether "the plan" means the rollout plan or the test plan.
obligations.description: The referential ambiguity must remain unresolved.

cases.source: The image signature was verified. The policy requires a signed known-good image.
cases.transformation: It is unclear whether the image is known-good despite the verified signature.
cases.purpose: Preserve the justified uncertainty about known-good status.

obligations.source_quote: The policy requires a signed known-good image.
obligations.description: The known-good requirement must remain open.
